posts.title: An Introduction to Factor-Augmented Vector Autoregression (FAVAR)
posts.description: Introduction As we saw in the post on vector autoregressive (VAR) models , traditional VAR models suffer from a so-called curse of dimensionality . Each additional variable adds a further equation and a further lag polynomial to every other equation, so the number of coefficients grows with the square of the number of variables.
